sentences.en: The school will conduct a fair test to ensure every student has the same chance.
sentences.zh: 学校将进行一次公平测试，以确保每个学生都有相同的机会。

sentences.en: Before implementing the new policy, they want to run a fair test in one district first.
sentences.zh: 在实施新政策之前，他们想先在一个区试行一次公平测试。

sentences.en: It's important that the exam is a fair test of students' abilities and knowledge.
sentences.zh: 重要的是考试要公平地测验学生的才能和知识。
